items.title: Where Could Boeing Stock Be In Five Years?
items.summary: Our Nov 11 piece, What's Going To Happen With Boeing Stock Soon?, found that management conceded on the Oct 27 call that steadying the 737 line at 47 jets a month is taking longer than it expected. Since the Nov 10 close before that piece, the stock has slipped another 1.1%, to $171.50 at Friday's close. The next question is the long one: where could Boeing stock be in five years.

items.title: Is Lockheed Martin (LMT) Below Fair Value After Its 98% Run?
items.summary: Lockheed Martin has delivered a 97.5% share price gain over the past 5 years, and with fresh contract news and industrial moves in play, the question now is whether that price really lines up with the cash the business can generate. After a long run like that, it becomes less about headlines and more about what the current valuation implies for future cash flows.
